preconditions.description: The input contains at least one line.

preconditions.expression: len(first_line_parts) == 2 and first_line_parts[0].isdigit() and len(first_line_parts[1]) == 26 and set(first_line_parts[1]) == set('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')
preconditions.description: The first line contains an integer T and a 26-character string M which is a permutation of the lowercase English alphabet, separated by a single space.
The number of subsequent lines equals T, the integer from the first line.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_.,!?' for c in s) for s in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence contains only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, underscores, and the specified punctuation symbols.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence is non-empty and has at most 100 characters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each input sentence.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == ''.join(translate_char(c, M) for c in sentences[i]) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each sentence, the output line is the translation where every character is mapped according to the rules: lowercase 'a'-'z' in Bytelandian maps to the corresponding character in M, uppercase 'A'-'Z' maps to the uppercase version of the corresponding character in M, underscores map to spaces, and punctuation remains unchanged.
